These operations participate in what can become a determinate object. Their reality lies in their work within the act, not in their being neutral space between a finished subject and a finished object. In the operator's containing inquiry the whole forecasting apparatus is means. manual_source_operation_boundaries.complete_paragraph: Consider a constructed greenhouse relay: a temperature forecast leads to a vent being opened; the achieved temperature then enters a subsequent forecast. The current model depends causally on the data and processes through which it was produced. A later physical condition depends partly on the action that model informed. These causal directions can form a feedback circuit.

A local description may be another system's input, a prediction another's object, an intervention another's unrecorded condition. There need not be one office able to inspect or revise all the legs. manual_source_operation_boundaries.complete_paragraph: The return is enacted when a subsequent possibility inherits the encounter's warranted consequence. A reading can be corrected at its source under an adequate rule; a model can change its inference; a failing evaluator can change what counts as success; a commission can change what the system is for. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons. A local system may enact some corrections and return others to the people or systems who hold the relevant authority. An accurate account keeps the proposed revision, its enactment and its inheritance distinct. A stronger claim that processing changed requires the actual changed condition and its effect on the later operation.
